messages:
neal: Quick report: after the latest q4b-int4 bringup we see a large hit on codebench exact-match for python snippets (exact down 18 pts). Need quick triage.
anya: Which quant flags and build?
neal: q4b-int4-opt, commit ea7c9d, flags: --bits=4 --g=128 --perchannel=true. Hosted baseline q8b shows only 2pt change.
devin: Any diff in golden used by the runner? automated dedupe or formatting changes recently?
neal: I diffed golden_v2 -> golden_v3 for codebench: 1400 total, 98 changed. Of those, 60 are formatting-only (indent, trailing comma), 38 semantic edits.
anya: Formatting-only should not break codebench. Are we doing strict text match for python?
neal: Yes, current pipeline uses strict-match. That explains part of the drop. But exact-match down even after normalizing whitespace. I suspect tokenization/indent normalization differences after quantized compile path.
devin: Two immediate mitigations: 1) freeze golden refresh for codebench, 2) add AST-based equivalence for python checks. We should also collect a diagnostic set focused on whitespace/indent edgecases.
neal: Agreed. Proposed quick plan:
- sample 300 python prompts with mixed indentation / unicode identifiers from seedbank (neal)
- freeze 120 golden candidates flagged as changed (send to label-ops for semantic review)
- implement AST-equivalence postprocess in codebench (devin)
- run eval matrix (hosted-q8b, q8b-int4, q4b-int4-opt) with both exact and AST metrics
label-ops: We can accept the 120-item batch with tag code-ast-review. ETA 48h for relabel.
devin: I'll sketch a minimal AST check: parse with ast.parse -> ast.dump(normalize_literals=True) and compare. Will PR a test harness.
curation-bot: Auto-golden refresh paused for pipeline codebench by eng-ml until 2026-03-26T09:00Z (reason: quantized model introduced formatting sensitivity).
anya: Also run a de-dupe overlap check on the seedbank; last week's dedupe param tweak might have changed sample frequencies and surfaced brittle examples.
neal: Good call. I'll include overlap stats in the diagnostic bundle.
devin: I'll run the eval matrix and upload results to internal storage (ETA ~90m). If AST-match recovers >12% of the delta we can treat as formatting noise; otherwise escalate to quant-bisect.
neal: Action items recap:
- neal: assemble 300 diagnostic samples + overlap report (due +2h)
- devin: add AST-postprocess + run eval matrix (due +2h)
- label-ops: relabel 120 frozen items (ETA 48h)
- eng-ml: hold golden refresh for codebench until checks complete
anya: Thanks. If we see more than 10 semantic changes among golden, we should consider a short backfill/migration script to align archived goldens.
neal: Noted. Will log findings in ticket CTC-1440 and ping infra if we need backfill.
